subject: Packaging and scope for admin-action history (SOC 2 / SIG evidence)
messages:
From: Lena Volk <lena.volk@novamed.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request — admin-action history + export format

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our upcoming SOC 2 / SIG evidence collection we need a few items from Redwood: what administrative and operator actions are logged, retention windows for each event class, and the export packaging options (manifest format, checksums, signing, and delivery modes).

Specifically:
- Canonical list of event types (admin role changes, privilege elevation, operator API calls, token/key operations, console logins, role bindings, model pinning/version changes).
- The default retention and the options for on-demand snapshotting or longer retention.
- Export formats you support (JSONL, Parquet), whether exports include per-record timestamps and actor ids, and how you attest integrity (manifest + HMAC or signed S3 objects).
- Delivery choices: S3 presigned URL, SFTP, encrypted bundle via portal, or streaming to a customer endpoint.

We need an export we can ingest into our compliance portal (CSV/JSONL + manifest). Target timeline is the next 7 business days; can you confirm feasibility and provide an example manifest/schema?

I've attached our evidence request form (novamed-evidence-req-20261124.pdf).

Thanks,
Lena

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin-action history + export format

Hi Lena — appreciate the clear ask and the attachment. Summary response below; I'll coordinate delivery.

What we log (summary):
- Administrative actions: role grants/revokes, IAM policy changes, service account creation/deletion, delegated admin approvals.
- Operator/runtime actions: model deploys/pin, config updates, scale/autoscale events, restart/reimage operations.
- Authentication/session events: successful/failed console logins, API key/token creation and revocation, refresh/renewal timestamps.
- Data plane calls (metadata): request metadata for inference calls (headers, model id, region, request id) but not raw prompt content unless customer has enabled debug capture.
- System-level events: node provisioning, autoscaling decisions, container restarts, health-check failures.

Retention & scope:
- Hosted API (default): 180 days for admin/action indexes; operational metadata (non-PII) up to 365 days for customers on enterprise retention add-on.
- Dedicated/Private: configurable per-contract — we can preserve full admin-action history for 365+ days on request (requires reserved capacity + retention addon).
- On-demand snapshots: we support attested snapshots (timeboxed) that we can export on request for a given window (e.g., 2026-10-01..2026-11-01).

Export options and integrity:
- Formats: JSONL (recommended for schema stability), Parquet (if you prefer columnar), and CSV for small summaries.
- Each record contains: iso_timestamp, tenant_id, actor_id (internal user id), actor_email (if not redacted), action_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, proto_version, region, metadata (freeform JSON).
- Integrity: we produce a signed manifest with per-file SHA256 checksums and a manifest HMAC signed with our transfer key. Optionally we can upload to your S3 with SSE-C or provide PGP-encrypted bundles.
- Delivery modes: S3 presigned (time-limited), SFTP drop, secure HTTPS transfer to your intake endpoint, or we can stage a bundle in a locked share and provide an attested receipt + signed manifest.

PII/redaction:
- By default actor_email is included for admin actors; we can redact or pseudonymize subject to the agreements. Any request for redaction will be applied during export and recorded in the manifest.

Next steps / asks from you:
1) Which export format do you prefer (JSONL / Parquet / CSV)?
2) Confirm window and timezone for the snapshot.
3) Preferred delivery (S3 presigned / SFTP / HTTPS / portal).
4) Any redaction rules we should apply (mask emails, remove IPs, etc.).

I've attached a sample manifest we use internally (admin-activity-manifest_v1.jsonl.gz) — it shows the manifest keys and the checksums. If that looks good we'll schedule the snapshot and deliver within 3 business days for a standard window, or 5 business days if you require per-record PII redaction.

Happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head, Product Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin-action history + export format

Grace / Soojin — quick internal notes for the export pack: 

- Manifest schema: manifest_version, export_window_start, export_window_end, tenant_id, file_count, total_bytes, checksum_algorithm, per_file: {file_name, sha256, record_count, compressed}, exporter_contact, hmac_signature.
- Compression: gzip for JSONL (we've standardized on .jsonl.gz).
- Retention for exported bundles: we keep the export staging copy for 14 days and then purge unless customer requests longer hold.
- Redaction: we can apply email pseudonymization (replace local-part with hash) and drop client IPs; must be requested explicitly.

Flagging an operational constraint: if NovaMed requests a historic window > 90 days back for hosted data and wants per-record PII unredacted, we'll need an elevated data retention exception (legal signoff) — as default hosted retention is 180 days but we limit detailed PII to 90 days unless enrolled in enterprise retention. Recommend asking them whether they need raw actor_email for the full range.

I'll produce the manifest template and a short readme for their ingestion.

—Ben
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Lena — thanks for the request; we can deliver the snapshot as discussed. Proposed plan: 

1) You confirm format = JSONL (.jsonl.gz), window = 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-11-01T23:59:59Z, delivery = S3 presigned + signed manifest, no IPs, include actor_email (pseudonymize local-part).
2) We stage the bundle in our custody bucket and provide the presigned URL + the signed manifest within 3 business days of confirmation.
3) We will keep the staging copy live for 14 days; we will provide an attestation email on delivery with manifest HMAC and SHA256 per file.
4) If you require raw actor_email and IP addresses for the entire window, please confirm and we'll route the request through retention-exceptions (adds ~2 business days for legal).

If that plan is 👍 we'll proceed and I will schedule the handoff and send the presigned link when ready.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
